actions.inlineHint: Before deletion the definition is copied into every test that points at it, so those tests keep working.

actions.inUseShort_other: Used by {{count}} records, so it can't be deleted

topology.title: Topology
topology.derived: The server worked this out from the parameters: which machines each role needs and how data flows between them.
topology.empty: Pick a DBMS and its parameters and the topology shows up here.

requirements.title: Hardware requirements
requirements.derived: How much CPU, memory and disk each role needs with these parameters and this workload.
requirements.empty: No hardware requirements: the target is external or a no-op.

reasons.wal_archive: {{engine}} minimum and room for the WAL archive
reasons.image_baseline: a database image: the stand's minimum
reasons.pdisks: {{pdisks}} pdisk(s) × at least 80 GB + 20 GB filesystem

usages.title: Where it is used
usages.hint: Tests and suites that point at this {{kind}}. You can’t delete it while they do.
usages.emptyDatabase: No test uses this database yet. Create one to run it.
usages.emptyWorkload: No test uses this workload yet.
usages.emptyTest: This test isn't in any suite or schedule.

validation.title: Validation
validation.doesNotFit_one: Does not fit. {{count}} error to fix.
validation.doesNotFit_other: Does not fit. {{count}} errors to fix.

import.title: Import {{kind}}
import.hint: Paste YAML or JSON with kind: {{kind}} or drop a file. The record is created as is, and the server checks it.
import.notDocument: Expected a document with kind, metadata and spec.

diff.title: Compare with another record
diff.hint: Pick another record of the same type to compare them field by field.

sizes.noDiskHint: This role gets the default boot disk.
sizes.autoHint: Picked automatically: the smallest preset that fits the role. You can choose another.

segments.title: Segments
segments.hint: Segments run one after another on the same stand, for example the data load, then OLTP, then OLAP.
segments.name: Name

options.title: Driver, connection, baseline
options.hint: stroppy runtime options. Anything you leave alone keeps its default.

configs.title: Software configs per role
configs.hint: Only your changes from the schema defaults are stored; the form shows the whole config.
configs.overviewHint: Config schemas by role, and how many keys you changed in each.
configs.none: No config schemas for this kind.
configs.allDefault: Everything is at its default. Turn on “Show all fields” to change something.

databases.title: Databases
databases.subtitle: The databases you test: engine, version, topology and tuning. Machines for them are picked in the test.
databases.schemaMissing: Schema {{id}} is not in the catalog.

empty.title: No databases yet
empty.hint: Describe a database once and use it in tests and suites.

workloads.title: Workloads
workloads.subtitle: stroppy scenarios: version, protocol and the segments that run in turn.

empty.title: No workloads yet
empty.hint: Describe a workload once and run it against different databases.

form.protocolHint: Protocols the selected stroppy version speaks. It has to match the database type.
form.firstSegmentHint: You'll add the other segments on the workload page.
form.runnerHint: The runner machine is sized by the largest VU count across segments.

tests.title: Tests
tests.subtitle: What to launch: a database, a workload and the machines for them.
tests.trendHint_one: {{count}} completed run with a headline metric.
tests.trendHint_other: {{count}} completed runs with a headline metric.
tests.noRunsHint: Launch the test and its history shows up here.
tests.revalidatedIssues: Validated. There are issues to fix.
tests.draftCannotLaunch: A draft can't be launched: finish the wizard first.
tests.inlineSpec: Defined right in the test, not taken from the library
tests.sizesHint: What each role needs and the size picked for it. You can change sizes at launch.

empty.title: No tests yet
empty.hint: A test ties a database, a workload and machine sizes together, and it is what you launch.

tests.finalizeHint: Open the last wizard step and check the test

launch.title: Launch {{name}}
launch.subtitle: Changes here apply to this run only; the test itself stays as it is.
launch.providerHint: Only providers that passed their check can be used.
launch.sizesHint: Machine sizes for this run. Whether they are big enough is checked as you go.
launch.keepHint: How long to keep the machines after the run, in Go format: 30m, 2h. 0s removes them right away.
launch.labelsHint: Your own key=value labels for finding runs later.

autoSizes.title: Sizes picked automatically
autoSizes.body: These roles had no size in the test, so each got the smallest preset that fits it. They're machines in your cloud that you pay for, so check them before launching.

wizard.intro: Four steps: database, workload, sizes and review. The draft is saved after the first one.
wizard.draftHint: The draft is saved on the server after every step, so you can come back to it.
wizard.pickDatabaseHint: Take a database from the library and the test picks up its changes. Or describe one right here, just for this test.
wizard.pickWorkloadHint: The workload's protocol has to match the database type; the server checks it.
wizard.protocolsHint: Pick a workload whose protocol {{kind}} accepts.
wizard.providerHint: Optional: you can pick the cloud at launch too. Suites pick their own.
wizard.sizesHint: The smallest sizes that fit are suggested. Bigger is fine.

db.name: Name
db.templateHint: Fills in the parameters for you; you can adjust them on the next step.

image.title: Database image
image.hint: The Docker image of the database itself: the primary and the replicas. Leave it empty and runs use the official image for this version. Set your own for a fork or a patched build; the login to a private registry comes from the provider profile. The image of a proxy or an exporter is changed in the container tweaks below.
image.label: Custom image
image.saved: Image saved; the next runs use it
image.spaces: An image name has no spaces. Example: ghcr.io/acme/postgres:17-patched

runtime.title: Run tweaks
runtime.hint: What to change in the containers and machines we bring up for this database. Database settings (postgresql.conf and the like) live on the Configs tab; this is for what a config can't say. The tweaks apply to every run with this database.
runtime.notMap: Expected a YAML map with keys like containers, additional_containers, host_prep.
runtime.empty: No tweaks; containers start the way the recipe makes them.
runtime.applied: Saved. The tweaks apply to every run with this database.
runtime.otherKeys: The tweaks hold keys the form doesn't show: {{keys}}. They are kept as they are; edit them in YAML.
runtime.fixAbove_one: {{count}} field has a problem, highlighted above.

containers.title: Container tweaks
containers.hint: Change the image, environment, command, or add a file to a container we make. Empty fields stay as the recipe sets them.
containers.cmdHint: One argument per line. It replaces the recipe command entirely, so write all of it.

env.label: Environment variables
env.hint: Added to the recipe variables; the same key overwrites its value.

files.label: Files
files.hint: Put into the container before it starts. A file at the same path as the recipe one replaces it. The second field is the mode, 0644 by default.

steps.title: Before the run, on the machines
steps.hint: Runs on the VM itself before any container starts: kernel parameters or a script of your own.

contentHint.script: A shell script run as root. A non-zero exit stops the run.
contentHint.disks: Disk layout; we normally do it ourselves.

extra.title: Your own containers
extra.hint: A container the recipe doesn't have: your exporter, agent or sidecar. It runs next to the database on the machine you pick, on the host network.
extra.name: Name
extra.portsHint: Comma-separated; the host port equals the container port.
extra.cmdHint: One argument per line. Empty means the image command.

help.intro: Run tweaks are a YAML map. Every key below is optional; write only what you change. We lay it over what the parameters and configs produce and check it before saving.
help.merge: How it applies: a field you set replaces the recipe value, env and files merge by key and path, lists are replaced whole. A selector that matches no container or machine fails the run instead of being skipped.

keys.containers: Tweaks to containers we make. Pick them by role (machine role), kind (database, proxy, exporter) or an exact name; set holds container fields: image, env, cmd, files, ulimits, healthcheck.
keys.host_prep: Steps on the VM before containers start: kind sysctl (sysctl.conf lines) or script (shell as root), for every machine of a role or one machine.
keys.additional_containers: Your containers next to the database. name, role, machine (machines are named <role>-<n>, e.g. db-1) and image are required.
keys.machines: Hardware of one machine over the test sizes: cpu, memory_gb, disks.
keys.scrapes: Where the agent collects Prometheus metrics from: usually an exporter from additional_containers.
